en: A big block of ice. Pushed, it would slide across the floor until something stopped it.
A big block of ice. Pushed, it would slide across the floor until something stopped it.
Skier Diana: I could slide across this ice with my eyes shut. Can you keep up?
text: Schior Diana: Aș putea aluneca pe gheața asta cu ochii închiși. Ții pasul?

en: Skier Diana: I took a tumble on that one.
text: Schior Diana: Am căzut la asta.

en: Boarder Patton: My Swinub love the cold. How about yours?
text: Snowboardist Patton: Swinub ai mei iubesc frigul. Dar ai tăi?
